article.title: “Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members, and Criminals to Fight the War on Terror” – book review
article.author: Editor
article.content: Kennard’s Irregular Army alarmingly exposes the open door to violent, far-right elements in the US army. This should be connected to imperial overreach, argues Reece Goscinski. The post “Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members, and Criminals to Fight the War on Terror” – book review appeared first on MR Online .
